items.title: 21.12 Fazai gardish aur fazai cells (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of atmospheric circulation and cells (PDF 181-182).

blocks.text: Angular momentum ka conservation (barqarar rehna) chalti hawa ke patterns banane mein aham kirdar ada karta hai. Hawa ki gardish (atmospheric circulation) par angular momentum ke conservation aur zameen ke ghoomne ka gehra asar hota hai. Zameen ke ghoomne wale mehwar (axis) ke gird hawa ke aik hisse (air mass) ka angular momentum L = mvr hai, jahan m hawa ki mass, r axis se us ka faasla aur v us ki velocity hai. Atmospheric science mein aam taur par specific angular momentum lete hain, yani har kilogram (unit mass) ka angular momentum:

Jab hawa equator se poles ki taraf (ya ulta) chalti hai to woh apni shuru wali latitude ka specific angular momentum saath rakhti hai. Pole ki taraf jate hue axis se faasla r kam hota hai, is liye rv barabar rakhne ke liye v (mashriq ki taraf raftar) barh jati hai. Zameen ki surface equator par zyada tezi se (mashriq ki taraf) chalti hai aur oonchi latitudes par aahista. Is liye equator se pole ki taraf jane wali hawa neeche ki zameen se tez mashriq ki taraf chalti hai aur aage nikal jati hai; zameen se dekhne par yeh mashriq ki taraf murti nazar aati hai, jo northern hemisphere mein us ki harkat ke daen (right) taraf hai. Pole se equator ki taraf jane wali hawa ulta karti hai: tez chalti zameen se peeche reh jati hai aur maghrib ki taraf murti hai, jo phir bhi northern hemisphere mein us ki daen taraf hai. Zameen ke ghoomne se chalti hawa ka yeh zahiri (apparent) murna Coriolis effect kehlata hai. Murna northern hemisphere mein daen aur southern hemisphere mein baen (left) taraf hota hai. Yeh hawa ki raftar nahi badalta, sirf us ka rasta badalta hai, jis se hawa ke mure hue patterns bante hain. In mure hue bahaon se har hemisphere mein hawa ki gardish ke teen alag cells bante hain: Hadley cell, Ferrel cell aur Polar cell. In cells ka khaaka Fig. 21.14 mein hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke equator se pole ki taraf jane wali hawa 'neeche ki surface ke ghoomne se peeche reh jati hai' (lags behind). Kitab ki apni daleel se (r kam, is liye v zyada) yeh hawa neeche ki zameen se tez mashriq ki taraf chalti hai, is liye aage nikal kar mashriq (northern hemisphere mein daen) ki taraf murti hai. Peeche woh hawa reh jati hai jo pole se equator ki taraf aati hai. Dono suraton mein northern hemisphere mein murna daen taraf hi hai.

blocks.alt: Zameen ka gola, beech mein khat-e-istiwa. Shimali nisf-kurrah mein qutb ki taraf aur khat-e-istiwa ki taraf chalti hawa ke teer daen taraf mur jate hain; junoobi nisf-kurrah mein baen taraf. Grey dashed teer seedha raasta, neele teer asal mura hua raasta. Oopar teer: zameen maghrib se mashriq ghoomti hai.
blocks.caption: Coriolis effect: shimal mein daen aur junoob mein baen taraf mor (hamara izafi khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chalti hawa apni raftar nahi badalti, sirf us ka rukh murta hai. Northern hemisphere mein hawa jis taraf bhi chale, apni daen taraf murti hai; southern hemisphere mein baen taraf. Isi se trade winds, westerlies aur polar easterlies tirchi chalti hain.

blocks.alt: Globe par arz-e-balad 60, 30, 0, 30, 60 darje. Is ke gird dono taraf aur dono nisf-kurron mein teeron ke band chakkar: surkh teer satah ke qareeb aur uthti hawa, neele teer oonchai par aur baithti hawa. Labels: khat-e-istiwa par Hadley Cells, 30 aur 60 darje ke darmiyan Ferrel Cell (chaar baar), oopar neeche Polar Cell.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.14: zameen ki fazai gardish mein cells banne ka khaaka (kitab ki Figure 21.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hadley cell mein garam hawa equator par uth kar oonchai par poles ki taraf jati aur 30 darje latitude ke qareeb neeche baithti hai. Polar cell mein thandi hawa poles par baith kar 60 darje ke qareeb uthti hai. Ferrel cell in dono ke darmiyan (30 se 60 darje) hai. Surface ke qareeb wapas aane wale bahao Coriolis effect se mur kar trade winds, westerlies aur polar easterlies bante hain.

blocks.prompt: Southern hemisphere mein chalti hawa kis taraf murti hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Apni harkat ke baen (left) taraf, zameen ke ghoomne ki wajah se (Coriolis effect, jo angular momentum ke conservation se samajh aata hai). Northern hemisphere mein daen taraf murti hai.

items: Chalti hawa specific angular momentum L = rv (21.6) barqarar rakhti hai.
Coriolis effect: northern mein daen, southern mein baen murna; raftar wahi rehti hai.
Har hemisphere mein teen cells: Hadley (0-30 darje), Ferrel (30-60), Polar (60-90).
